id.description: The unique identifier for the interactionLogEntry.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

contactId.description: The unique identifier for the contact.

entryNo.description: The unique entry number for the interaction log entry.

date.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the interactionLogEntry was first created in the owning system.

description.description: A detailed description of the interaction log entry.

salespersonId.description: The unique identifier for the salesperson associated with the interaction log entry.

userId.description: The unique identifier for the user who created the interaction log entry.

interactionGroup.description: The code representing the interaction group.

interactionTemplate.description: The code representing the interaction template.

campaignNo.description: The unique campaign number associated with the interaction log entry.

campaignDescription.description: A brief description of the campaign associated with the interaction log entry.

segmentNo.description: The unique segment number associated with the interaction log entry.

segmentDescription.description: A brief description of the segment associated with the interaction log entry.

documentType.description: The code representing the document type associated with the interaction log entry.

documentNo.description: The unique document number associated with the interaction log entry.

documentversionNo.description: The unique document version number associated with the interaction log entry.

fileattachmentLink.description: A link to the file attachment associated with the interaction log entry.

fileattachmentBase64.description: The base64 encoded content of the file attachment associated with the interaction log entry.
